title: Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo
summary: While Patient Defence is active, use a Reaction to counter a missed melee attack.

fields.Effect: While Patient Defence is active, use a Reaction to make an unarmed strike against a creature that misses you with a melee attack.
fields.Base value: 250 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported reach exception: The pinned source says the reaction does not check normal unarmed reach and can trigger on a missed melee attack from farther away.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
